Cross border movement from Scotland to another part of the 
UK

1.
 
 This memo gives guidance on 
The Scotland Act 2016 (Social Security) (Adult Disability Payment and 
Child Disability Payment) (Amendment) Regulations 2022
, which come into force on 21. 03. 22
1
.
1 Scotland Act 2016 (SS) (ADP and CDP) (Amdts) Regs 2022; SI 2021 No.335

2. The Scottish Government (SG) is due to introduce Adult Disability Payment (ADP)
1
 
from March 2022. 
This is to replace PIP for working age adults resident in Scotland.

1.
 
prevent payment of AA and DLA if ADP is in payment
 and

2.
 
in cases of cross-border movement from Scotland to another part of the UK, for a claimant who has
  
reached state pension age where they make a claim for AA, this will start where entitlement is
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
assessed
 
and confirmed,
 
after the 13 week ADP run-on payment has ended.

4. The legislation provides that a person shall not be entitled to AA while they are entitled to ADP in order 
to prevent duplicate payment of the two benefits
1
. As a result, ADP will be listed as an incompatible 
benefit with AA
 
 under appendix 1 of DMG paragraph 
17005
.
1 Social Security Contributions and Benefits Act 1992 s 64(1A)(aa)

5. The legislation provides that a person shall not be entitled to DLA while they are entitled to ADP in 
order to prevent duplicate payment of the two benefits
1
. As a result, ADP
 
 will be listed as an 
incompatible benefit with DLA
 
 under appendix 1 of DMG paragraph 
17005
.
1 Social Security Contributions and Benefits Act 1992 s 71(7)

CROSS BORDER MOVEMENT FROM SCOTLAND TO ANOTHER PART
 
OF THE UK

1.
 
is a recipient of ADP 
and

2.
 subsequently moves from Scotland to another part of the UK

retains entitlement to ADP for a period of 13 weeks beginning with the date of the move from 
Scotland
1
.
1 Disability Assistance for Working Age People (Scotland) Regulations 2022, reg 53(1)

7.
 
 
 
 If the circumstances in paragraph 6 apply, claimants are to be treated as

2.
 
 
not habitually resident in the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, the Isle of Man or the
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
Channel
 
Islands
1 SS (AA) Regs 1991, reg2 (1ZA), SS (DLA) Regs 1991, reg2 (1ZB)

This memo 2-22 should be annotated against the following DMG paragraph: 
Appendix 1 of DMG 17005

If you have any queries about this memo, please write to Decision Making and Appeals (DMA) Leeds, 3E 
zone E, Quarry House, Leeds. Existing arrangements for such referrals should be followed, as set out in – 
Memo 
4/19
 Requesting case guidance from DMA Leeds for all benefits.
